line.sw: Jina la Kenya la kikundi cha akiba. Vingine huzungusha malipo; vingine hujenga mfuko wa pamoja.
line.en: A Kenyan name for a savings group. Some rotate payouts; others build a shared fund.

line.sw: Jina linalotumika Tanzania kwa kikundi cha akiba na mikopo cha mzunguko.
line.en: A name used in Tanzania for a rotating savings and credit group.

line.sw: Jina linalotumika Ghana na kwingineko Afrika Magharibi kwa kikundi cha akiba na mikopo cha mzunguko.
line.en: A name used in Ghana and elsewhere in West Africa for a rotating savings and credit group.

line.sw: Jina linalotumika Indonesia kwa kikundi cha akiba na mikopo cha mzunguko.
line.en: A name used in Indonesia for a rotating savings and credit group.

line.sw: Jina linalotumika Peru kwa kikundi cha akiba na mikopo cha mzunguko.
line.en: A name used in Peru for a rotating savings and credit group.

line.sw: Jina la Afrika Kusini la vilabu vya akiba vinavyomilikiwa na wanachama, ambavyo vinaweza kulipa kwa mzunguko au kujenga mfuko wa pamoja.
line.en: A South African name for member-owned savings clubs, which may pay out in rotation or build a shared fund.
